answer: Demurrage taxes every key that holds POA without working. Each key keeps its own 100 POA yarrow deposit, and every epoch it signs no work the protocol burns one copper, a 2 POA unit, from it. A fake must cross a 50-epoch horizon before its first payout, so waiting burns 50 coppers = 100 POA per fake. Then 1,000 fakes x 100 POA = 100,000 POA burned, and the attacker pays 100,000 POA.
